name: 31520 · Brunswick, GA
findings: ZIP 31520 (Brunswick) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31520 (Brunswick) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 31520 (Brunswick) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
